# Oppelt 2018

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::read_chunk("plots.R")
```

NFκB signalling in HepG2 cells after TNFα, and its change by drugs that cause liver injury, after
Oppelt et al. (2018), npj Syst Biol Appl 4:23. The full model of the publication has 38 reactions
in cytoplasm and nucleus and starts from the resting state of the cells, a steady state that
`Pimpl()` solves numerically. The project extends it at the receptor, which saturates and is also
activated by a ligand the cells secrete, and takes the extension out again by the symmetries and
the profiles. 312 measurements of live-cell imaging and immunoblots in untreated and stimulated
cells determine the model; 444 further measurements, 408 of them with one of five compounds,
determine the changes the compounds cause. The data are those of the publication; the model is
Daniel Kaschek's implementation in dMod (dkaschek/dMod_Examples, TNFa). The
[guide](https://dmodverse.github.io/dMod2/articles/guide-model.html) goes through the code.

## Files

| file | content |
|---|---|
| `data/oppelt2018.csv` | the measurements of the publication |
| `model.R` | data, the full model, its resting state, conditions, compiling, objective, the gauge |
| `symmetries.R` | the Lie symmetries of the full model and their reduction, saves `results/symmetries.rds` and `results/reduction.rds` |
| `fit.R` | multistart of 500 fits, saves `results/fits.rds` |
| `sensitivities.R` | forward and reverse gradient and the exact Hessian at the best fit, saves `results/sensitivities.rds` for the guide |
| `optimizers.R` | the Hessian sources of `trust()` from the same 100 starts, saves `results/optimizers.rds` for the guide |
| `profiles.R` | profiles of all parameters with a wide prior, saves `results/profiles.rds` |
| `reduced.R` | the model reduced by the limits the profiles point to |
| `refit.R` | fit and profiles of the reduced model, likelihood ratio, saves `results/reduced.rds` |
| `prediction.R` | prediction band of nuclear IκBα, saves `results/prediction.rds` |
| `compounds.R` | the changes the compounds cause, by spike-and-slab random effects, saves `results/compounds.rds` |
| `petab.R` | the model as a PEtab problem with its resting state as a pre-equilibration, written to `results/petab/` and read back |
| `plots.R` | figures from the saved results |
| `results/` | saved results |

## Run

With this folder as working directory, in this order:

```r
source("model.R")        # about a minute, mostly compiling into build/
source("symmetries.R")   # seconds, needs the Python package symident
source("fit.R")          # about 12 core hours
source("sensitivities.R")
source("optimizers.R")
source("profiles.R")     # about 15 core hours
source("refit.R")        # about 3 core hours
source("prediction.R")   # about 2 core hours
source("compounds.R")    # about 70 minutes on 20 cores
source("petab.R")        # about a minute
source("plots.R")
```

`model.R` uses the free cores of the machine. `plots.R` only reads `results/`.

```{r, include = FALSE}
source("model.R", local = TRUE)
fitted <- file.exists("results/fits.rds")
```

```{r load, echo = FALSE, eval = fitted}
```

## Fit

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
if (fitted) {
  cat(sprintf("%d fits, %d converged. The best value is %.3f, reached by %d fits within 0.1.\n",
              nrow(fits), sum(fits$converged), min(fits$value), sum(fits$value < min(fits$value) + 0.1)))
} else cat("> Results pending: `results/fits.rds` is written by `fit.R`.\n")
```

```{r waterfall, echo = FALSE, eval = fitted}
```

```{r prediction, echo = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8, eval = fitted}
```

## Reduction

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
if (file.exists("results/reduced.rds")) {
  r <- readRDS("results/reduced.rds")$ratio
  cat(sprintf("The profiles of the full model lead to a model with %d fewer parameters, whose data term is %.1f higher, below the 95%% threshold of %.1f; every parameter of the reduced model is determined. The [chapter on profile likelihood](https://dmodverse.github.io/dMod2/articles/guide-profiles.html) shows the limits.\n",
              as.integer(r[["removed"]]), r[["difference"]], r[["threshold"]]))
} else cat("> Results pending: `results/reduced.rds` is written by `refit.R`.\n")
```

## Prediction

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
predicted <- file.exists("results/prediction.rds")
if (!predicted) cat("> Results pending: `results/prediction.rds` is written by `prediction.R`.\n")
```

The 95% band of nuclear IκBα, which no experiment measured, from prediction profiles of the
reduced model:

```{r band, echo = FALSE, fig.height = 3.5, eval = predicted}
```

## Compounds

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
grouped <- file.exists("results/compounds.rds")
if (!grouped) cat("> Results pending: `results/compounds.rds` is written by `compounds.R`.\n")
```

The changes of the rate constants by the five compounds, from spike-and-slab random effects; the
colour is the mode of a change on the log scale, its opacity the evidence against no change:

```{r changes, echo = FALSE, fig.height = 5, eval = grouped}
```
